metadata.description: Exact public 0xSero GLM 5.3 Flash EXL3 K2 2.0bpw checkpoint (mcg codebook, 133 weight shards plus the EXL3 sidecar manifests upstream downloads, native unquantized MTP layer 45): the repository start.sh serves it as-is. The card names it the provenance-verified twin of the K2 staging artifact; the GitHub repository description calls the quantization 2.33 bpw while its scripts and docs say 2.0 bpw.
